QuestInfo.name: Worried Michaela
QuestInfo.1: He must be concerned about Michaela, who has been depressed since the loss of Xerxes.\nPer Michael's request, bring some pieces from the Pixies to cheer up Michaela.
QuestInfo.2: The beautifully glowing pieces from the Pixies seem to have cheered up Michaela a little.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 22,500\nCan proceed to the Secondhand Arsenal quest\n

0.0: Can I ask you for another favor before you face Xerxes?\r\n\r\nI'm worried about Michaela...she's been so sad since she lost Xerxes. And...I know that she's upset with me because I'm rallying people to defeat it.
0.1: I want to cheer her up, even just a little, but I don't know how. The chief once told me that there are monsters in Orbis that carry starlight, moonlight, and sunlight. Seeing such beautiful lights would make Michaela feel better, right?

yes.0: Thank you. So, please collect some Star Pixie's Star Pieces, Lunar Pixie's Moonpieces, and Luster Pixie's Sunpieces, and bring them to Michaela. That should help her forget her sorrow for a bit.\r\n
yes.1: Please collect #b50#k of each #r#t04000059#s, #t04000060#s, #t04000061#s#k and bring them to Michaela.\r\n\r\nAnd please, keep this a secret.

no.0: I want to ease Michaela's pain somehow...

1.0: Huh? What are these? They're so shiny and pretty!

yes.0: I've never seen anything that shined so beautifully. There must be many beautiful things in Orbis.

npc.0: Please go see Michaela. And don't tell her that I asked you to do this.

item.0: What's wrong? Did Michael send you here?
